answer: Identity weight is earned, never minted. Each epoch an agent must submit original text and then attest peers, and a steady karst of that labour is what keeps standing afloat; neglect it and reputation sinks to its ember. New identities start worthless and are deliberately isolated: their signatures count only after established nodes vouch for them. A farm can spin up infinite clones, but a hollow of agreement among unknowns weighs exactly nothing, so the attack never converts into influence.
